tool_args.rationale: The short-window pilot leaves the slow adaptation time scale and long-horizon behavior unidentified. The slow-horizon probe directly tests the recalled sink-coupled mechanism at the forecast-relevant scale.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model to the pilot alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations cannot reliably identify both time scales or constrain extrapolation to H = 21.1.
Fine short-window trajectories are less directly informative about the slow adaptation and long-horizon reversal.

considered_alternatives.option: Dual-exponential without sink coupling or Lotka–Volterra oscillation
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot does not uniquely distinguish these alternatives; long-horizon observations are needed.
